About the Leucadia Cyclery Sunday Social Ride group ride

A beginner-friendly Sunday morning spin along the coast from the shop, 15 to 20 miles at 10 to 12 mph. Just show up or call the store. The shop also lists a Wednesday evening intermediate ride and a Saturday women's group with rotating starts.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
